scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/shared && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/database
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,workers -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:workers"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/shared && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/database && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/workers && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/ai && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/api && npm run build -w @ai-newsroom/web
